ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (yellowish-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity yellowish-white contiguous regions are situated on the distal thirds of both lobes, featuring internal low-intensity mottling. The medial regions, peduncle attachment area, and the entirety of the trailing edge border are characterized by low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression with a defined vertex; estimated internal angle of 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the distal 60% of both trailing edges. Multiple distinct peaks (approx. 8-12 per lobe) with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 pixels from the baseline edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature of the trailing edges from the median notch extending to the tips, with a sharp anterior-directed curve at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast, textured circular and irregular pixel groups (orange, red, and white) at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe. Isolated white circular pixels are scattered across the low-intensity dark medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, near-vertical high-contrast linear disruptions located within the left lobe's high-intensity zone. Multiple thinner, unaligned diagonal and vertical linear marks are visible across the central and right lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive bio-fouling/barnacle colonization at the left fluke tip displaying reddish-orange and white coloration; prominent vertical linear scarring on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique reddish-orange pixel signatures within the barnacle cluster at the left tip, distinct from the primary pigmentation palette.
